root_cause.text: The st_lsm6dsx driver allows setting a buffer sampling frequency for sensor types other than accelerometer, but the underlying `st_lsm6dsx_check_odr()` function uses a fixed-size ODR table (only 2 entries for accelerometer and gyroscope), leading to an out-of-bounds access when `sensor->id` is an unsupported type.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "calls st_lsm6dsx_check_odr(), which accesses the odr_table array at index `sensor->id`; since this array is only 2 entries long, an access for any sensor type other than accelerometer or gyroscope is an out-of-bounds access." The patch fixes this by only passing buffer attributes for `ST_LSM6DSX_ID_ACC`, preventing the attribute from being created for other sensor IDs.
